import ledger


def record(acct, cents, note):
    minor_units = int(cents)
    sign = "-" if minor_units < 0 else "+"
    digits = str(abs(minor_units))
    check = sum(int(digit) for digit in digits) % 10
    amount = f"{sign}{digits}#{check}"
    return ledger.post(acct, amount, memo=note)
